resolved_findings.finding: Failed map completion previously published a reusable slot while pinned wgpu public map_context remained mapped; next submission could panic. Blind unmap is not a safe recovery for core Idle mapping.
resolved_findings.resolution: Source003 consumes Readback once then permanently retires that slot. Reserve only selects Idle; retired count is public; no buffer replacement allocation. All-three-retired and decoded-Reversed-reuse regressions cover the bookkeeping boundary.

Success drops mapped view and unmaps before publishing Ready; callback does not acquire graph lock and graph/pool lock order has no inverse path
Seven actual graph passes carry explicit optional query indices without assuming schedule registration order; frame excludes later UI/readback/presentation by documented scope
Integer tick subtraction precedes f64 conversion; finite positive f32 period and bounded fixed payload; reversed/wrapped interval explicitly refused
Cargo manifests and lock are byte-identical to freeze base; no dependency or runtime capability widening
